items.title: US Orders Civilian Agencies to Rip DeepSeek Out of Government Systems
items.summary: The Department of Homeland Security told civilian agencies to remove China's DeepSeek and any service built on it, and banned buying more, citing the risk of sensitive data reaching Beijing.
items.titleZh: 美国命令民间机构将DeepSeek从政府系统中剥离
items.summaryZh: 国土安全部告诉民间机构删除中国的DeepSeek和任何基于它的服务，并禁止购买更多服务，理由是敏感数据有可能到达北京。

items.title: ‘An army of Claudes, with every one asking for my attention’: Anthropic calls human attention the bottleneck in the botsitting world to come
items.summary: Claude sessions spend 80% of their time waiting on a person, and the median Anthropic employee spends 20% more of their time in meetings than a year ago.
items.titleZh: “一支由克劳德组成的军队，每个人都在寻求我的关注”：Anthropic将人类的注意力称为未来两个世界的瓶颈
items.summaryZh: Claude会话将80%的时间花在等待一个人上，Anthropic员工在会议上花费的时间比一年前多20%。

items.title: Bitcoin Tests Key Support as Oil and AI Fears Squeeze Markets
items.summary: Bitcoin keeps limping back to the same floor while $108 oil and 5% yields weigh on risk assets. The chart shows a coiled spring, not a trend.
